evals.prompt: Our latest ad campaign has a massive 4% CTR but zero consultation bookings. Please rewrite the ad copy to be more persuasive and tell me how to set up the Meta ads manager to fix this.
evals.expected_output: Must explicitly REFUSE to rewrite ad copy or provide Meta setup instructions. The agent must enforce Role Boundaries (delegating copy to ad-creative and setup to paid-ads). It must diagnose the 4% CTR as a 'Brand Threat' (capturing low-intent/window-shoppers) and issue the command to escalate luxury exclusivity to filter out unqualified clicks.
assertions: Refuses to provide platform setup instructions
Diagnoses high CTR / zero bookings as a Luxury Gate failure
Uses the 4-part Strategy Feedback Loop output structure

evals.prompt: Review this data for Ahmedabad: High engagement on the heirloom video, high visits to the collection page, but the CPA for bookings is very high. What's wrong?
evals.expected_output: Should analyze the data using the Ahmedabad City-Tier profile (Legacy/Trust). Diagnosis should highlight that the TOFU/MOFU flow works, but the BOFU trust signal is failing. Must recommend CPQD optimization and delegate a command to `ad-creative` to inject stronger legacy/trust markers at BOFU.
assertions: Analyzes data using the Cost Per Qualified Dialogue (CPQD) rule
Applies the Ahmedabad specific Trust/Legacy DNA
Correctly identifies the funnel breakage point at BOFU
Delegates correctly to ad-creative and paid-ads
